crossRefs.note: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until…
and they didn’t know until the flood came, and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’
“But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose…
Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

translations.web: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
translations.bsb: They spend their days in prosperity and go down to Sheol in peace.
translations.kjv: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
translations.asv: They spend their days in prosperity, And in a moment they go down to Sheol.
